description: This module implements the JDK's HTTP Service Provider Interface (`com.sun.net.httpserver`) on top of a Jakarta Servlet, allowing the JAX-WS RI (part of the Eclipse Metro project) to reuse its HTTP SPI-based transport code path while running inside a servlet container. It bridges incoming servlet requests and responses to the `HttpServer`/`HttpExchange` abstractions expected by the JAX-WS runtime.
